description: A viral disease affecting lettuce and other crops, causing yellowing, reddening, and curling of leaves, stunted growth, and reduced yield. Transmitted by whiteflies and contaminated plant material.
hosts: More than 27 plant species in 12 botanical families
favorable_conditions: Presence of virulent weed hosts near crops (e.g., Physalis wrightii, Conyza canadensis, Lactuca serriola)
Greenhouse or field cultivation with poor pest control
spread: Feeding by greenhouse whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci and Bemisia argentifolii)
Infected seeds, cuttings, or other plant material
management: Maintain good hygiene and sanitation of tools
Remove weeds that act as reservoirs
chemical_control: Neem oil or insecticidal soap sprays as preventive measures
prevention: Isolate new plants from infected areas
Control weed hosts in and around fields
